KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_FEATUREDESCRIPTION_BODY: Trials are a collection of challenging scenarios; testing the skills of the most veteran Raiders. When competing in a Trial, you only earn a score if you manage to return safely to Speranza. Your highest score determines your position on the leaderboard, which may gain or lose you rank at the end of the rank period. A Trials season is made up of multiple rank periods; at the end of the season, you will receive rewards based on your final rank.

KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_1: If you have no Trials score at the end of the week, you will automatically be demoted.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_4: Once a new Trials season begins, you will start a few ranks lower than where you finished in the previous season, depending on your final rank.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_TRIALS_DESCRIPTION_1: Achieve personal bests in weekly Trials objectives to earn rewards such as weapons, rare materials, and blueprints.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_TRIALS_DESCRIPTION_2: Compete in weekly Trials and climb the leaderboards to earn exclusive rank-based rewards at the end of each season.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_OBJECTIVES_DESCRIPTION_: Each week introduces five new objectives. Earn score by achieving personal bests and returning home safely.
Every objective offers three possible rewards, granted the first time you surpass milestone thresholds.
Objective scores have no point limit.
Completing objectives under Major Map Conditions grants bonus score.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_LEADERBOARDS_DESCRIPTIO: Each week, you are placed in a leaderboard group with other Raiders of the same rank, competing for the highest total Trials Objective score.
Trials scores reset at the end of the week, and you are placed in a new group when scoring on the next set of objectives.
Depending on your leaderboard placement, you may be promoted or demoted to a new rank.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_2: If you participate in Trials during the Trials season, you will receive rewards at the end based on your final rank.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_3: The top players from the Hotshot and Cantina Legend ranks are placed in the Cantina Legend rank at the start of each new week.
KeysToEntries.ID_MASTERY_BETWEEN_SEASON_DID_NOT_PARTIC: You did not participate in this season
